record.t: Became Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Mississippi on February 1, 2019.

record.t: Became a Presiding Justice of the Supreme Court of Mississippi on January 1, 2013 (2013).

record.t: Was first elected to the Mississippi Supreme Court in November 2004 and re-elected to eight-year terms in 2012 and 2020.
record.q: Justice Randolph was first elected in November 2004, and re-elected for eight-year terms in November 2012 and November 2020.

record.t: Was appointed to the Mississippi Supreme Court by the governor.
record.q: Randolph was appointed to the Mississippi Supreme Court by Gov.

record.t: Was appointed by President Ronald Reagan to the National Coal Council.
record.q: Justice Randolph was appointed by President Ronald Reagan to serve on the National Coal Council.

record.t: Founded the firm Bryan Nelson Randolph, PA, serving as president and CEO until his appointment.
record.q: He opened a Hattiesburg office for Bryan, Nelson, et al in 1976, and later formed the firm of Bryan Nelson Randolph, PA., serving as President and CEO until his appointment to the Supreme Court.
